timers.name: Spacetime Rift
timers.line: A portal to the other faction's land opens for 10 minutes; inside, one hour of cross-faction PvP, sealed dungeons and quests.
about: Abyss Points for kills and the rift quests
Uru's four quests: about 21,000 to 58,000 Kina and 2,000 Abyss Points each, plus a ring, earrings, a bracelet and titles
Sealed Dungeons and Strongholds on the other side: quick, small drops
Field bosses over there drop gear for skins or supply requests
Stay longer with Spacetime Rift Duration Tickets (10 or 30 minutes)

timers.name: Watcher Kaira
timers.line: Lower Abyss field boss, every three hours at a random spot in the Black Fragments Area (Abandoned Island).
about: The Kaira set: helm, pauldrons, greaves, gloves, boots, cloak, necklace, earrings, ring, and the item level 62 Kaira Breastplate
Proof of Hero (Kaira): 5 for ranks 1 to 3, down to 1 from rank 31

timers.name: Siege bosses
timers.line: Right after the Artifact Siege: Executors Tamasa, Argo and Kaira in the Lower Abyss.
about: Materials that make a Dimensional Merit Chest
The chests can hold Potential Stone: Abyss (Unique or Heroic)

timers.name: Guardian Lord Nahma
timers.line: Guardian Lord Nahma rises in the Lower Abyss.
about: The Fallen Ancient God set, item level 46, greatsword included
Proof of Hero (Nahma): 10 for rank 1, down to 1 from rank 101
